# Camera fixture provenance

Minimal attributed extracts model the official XIX Legislature distributions
and vote-detail HTML. The detail values were observed on 2026-08-10 at:

`https://documenti.camera.it/apps/votazioni/votazionitutte/schedaVotazione.asp?Legislatura=19&RifVotazione=599_44&tipo=dettaglio`

The page reported final nominal vote 44, sitting 599, 22 January 2026, PDL
1311, with 216 present, 190 voting, 26 abstaining, 190 in favour, and 0
against. Participant rows are a deliberately small attributed extract, not a
redistribution of the complete page. Camera data is CC BY-SA 4.0.
